page.layout: One text page. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top left. Single column of running text, with an italic verse passage set indented in the middle. Greek and Latin notes below the text, in the same column. No margin notes. Closing line centred at the foot.

main_text.p: Quod rectius Plinius lib.2.cap.45. explicat: Montium vero flexus(inquit)crebrique vertices & conflexa cubito: aut confracta in humeros iuga, concavi vallium sinus:scindunt inaequaliter inde resultantem aera: quae causa etiā voces multis in locis reciprocas facit.
Aufonij elegantissimum extat Epigramma de Echo,inter Epigrammatai 2.est.

p.i: Vane quid affectas faciem mihi ponere pictor. Ignotamque oculis solicitare deam? Aëris & linguae sum filia, mater inanis Iudicij, vocem quae sine mente gero. Extremos pereunte modos, à fine reducens, Ludificata sequor verba aliena meis. Auribus in vestris habito penetralibus Echo: At si vis similem pingere, pinge sonum.

main_text.p: Verum hic Famam intelligit. similis fuit superius hymno 8.idolopœia Epodo 4.
Μελαντεχία[?] δόμον, hoc est, σκοτεινόν[?] tenebricosam domum, periphrasi infernum dixit.
Proserpina φερσεφόνη dicitur, quasi dicas φέρβουσα ἄφενος[?], ubertatem afferens, quia fruges & femina terrae seruat: à Plutone rapta, inde hic tenebricosam domū Proserpinæ inferos dicit.

Τίον, ἐπίτης.)Instructio Famae, quid apud inferos expedire debeat, per νέων χαρτῶν, à parte ætatem describit, iuuenem adhuc vicisse in Olympiis. ἡλέγιον, alis, ἀμμιγὰ[?] intelligit, coronas ex ramo oleastri flexas. χαῖτα, Latinis hinc seta dicitur, vt equi, leonis à χαίτη. nam ἐν τῷ τρέχειν τὸ ζῷον, dum currit illud animal χαίτη & ἀίσσειν dicitur χαῖτα. Latini seta apro & sui proprie tribuunt: ad hominem κατὰ μεταφορὰν transfertur, quia coma currenti circa caput fluitat.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the citation "lib.2.cap.45." has its numerals in old form (the 2 looks like z) and "45" is unclear; the Greek words in the first note paragraph, "Μελαντεχία", "σκοτεινόν", "φέρβουσα ἄφενος", "ἐπίτης", "ἀμμιγὰ" and the other Greek forms are read from a small, worn scan and are not certain. "vallium" is uncertain. The verse text is given as printed; long s is normalised to s. Print line-ends in the verse are treated as line breaks inside one italic paragraph. Printing forms "Aufonij" and "Epigrammatai" kept as printed. Scan is slightly skewed; no damage to words other than the marked places.
